prose: Bloomberg reports Chinese AI chipmaker Moore Threads posted Q3 revenue up 1,774% year over year to about $240 million, with a net profit around $7.4 million. The company is building a domestic 100,000-GPU cluster with JD.com.
highlights: Moore Threads Q3 revenue +1,774% YoY to ~$240M
~$7.4M net profit - rare profitability among Chinese AI chip startups
Building a 100K-GPU domestic cluster with JD.com
basis: The fetch failed with HTTP 403 (Bloomberg paywall), so this entry is based on the Techmeme feed summary and headline.
